description: Compare 2-5 exact published offers by listing slug and offer key. Returns published price, currency, availability, configuration, seller facts, and per-item errors. Preserves currencies and price text without currency conversion or declaring a cheapest option. Does not validate checkout or hold inventory.

offer.description: Exact published offer key, for example services-0.

slug.description: Exact published listing slug, not a URL.
